lead: One hundred knives, one hundred numbers.
The Edition 100 is a damascus folding knife made by Andreas Ulbrich, limited to 100 numbered pieces. 90 belong to the regular edition at €699 each; 10 are reserved as special pieces.

items.x: 10 special pieces: execution and higher price are agreed personally
You choose your serial number from the free numbers 1–90; special pieces 91–100 by arrangement
Blade length, overall length, weight, steel and handle material are available on request – ask by email before you order.
Payment is by bank transfer; your order is confirmed once payment has been received. Shipping within Germany costs €7.99 per item, with delivery expected within 7–14 working days of prompt payment.

Outside Germany, we ship if you cover all costs involved. Customs duties or import taxes, where they apply, are added to the price. You can also [collect your knife](/en/shipping/) at the workshop and pay in cash or by card.
Many countries have their own rules on importing folding knives. Please check what applies in your country before ordering.
Each knife comes with a care booklet and a care product, free of charge, and our [lifetime sharpening guarantee](/en/warranty/): free resharpening as often as needed.

faq.q: How many knives are there in the Edition 100?
faq.a: 100 numbered pieces: 90 regular knives at €699 each and 10 special pieces.

faq.q: Can I choose my serial number?
faq.a: You choose your serial number from the free numbers 1–90; special pieces 91–100 by arrangement.

faq.q: Do you ship knives outside Germany?
faq.a: Yes, if you cover all costs involved – shipping, insurance and any fees. Alternatively, you can collect your knife from the workshop in person.
If customs duties or import taxes apply, they are added to the price.

faq.q: Is there a warranty on the Edition 100?
faq.a: Statutory warranty rights apply, and our lifetime sharpening guarantee means we resharpen the knife free of charge as often as needed.
